verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's marketing pages mention 'Agents' that 'monitor your product continuously, surface insights before you think to ask, and tell your team exactly what to do next' and AI-generated summaries for replays/heatmaps, suggesting some built-in AI assistant functionality. However this is only vague marketing copy with no documentation of how a user actually delegates a task, what the assistant can do, or its scope/limits — the more concrete AI integration (MCP) is for external assistants connecting to Mixpanel, not a built-in assistant inside the product. Missing for 10: detailed product docs on the in-app AI assistant's capabilities, examples of delegated tasks, and independent/hands-on confirmation it works as described.
